DOP: 1 chanda m. , chanda(s) 1 , n. ( and ~ā, f. ?) ( sg. nom. ~o; acc. ~aṃ; instr. ~ena, ~asā; pl. nom. ~ā) [ S. chanda, chandas; BHS chanda], desire; longing for; will ; ( i ) in a bad sense: desire, appetite (for, loc.); affection; partiality ; Abh 162; 945; Vin I 21, 20* (rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā ettha me vigato ~o); II 285, 12 (~ā dosā mohā bhayā agatiṃ gantuṃ); IV 38, 3 foll. (~āya Dabbo Mallaputto senāsanaṃ paññāpeti ~āya ca bhattāni uddisatī ti; dat. or f. ? Sp 771, 1 : ~āyā ti ~ena pakkhapātena, attano attano sandiṭṭhasambhattānaṃ paṇītāni paññāpetī ti adhippāyo); D I 25, 6 (yattha me assa ~o vā rāgo vā doso vā paṭigho vā taṃ mam’ assa musā; Sv 116, 22 : ~o dubbalarāgo rāgo balavarāgo); II 277, 21 (~o … vitakka-nidāno vitakkasamudayo vitakkajātiko vitakkapabhavo); M I 123, 26 (ye gehasitā ~ā ye gehasitā vitakkā); 191, 4 (pañcas’ upādānakkhandhesu ~o ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo); Sn 835 (nāhosi ~o api methunasmiṃ); Th 1105 (padālaye kāmaguṇesu ~aṃ); Ja IV 116, 20* (paradāraṃ ca disvāna ~o me upapajjatha); Nidd I 2, 6 (~o kāmo rāgo kāmo chandarāgo kāmo …); 262, 13 foll. (pañca ~ā …); Peṭ 246, 4 (rāgena ~ā agatiṃ gacchati); Spk II 234, 5 (Ānandattherassa satthari adhimatto ~o ca pemaṃ ca); — ifc see kāma-; — ( ii ) in a good or neutral sense: will, intention; appetite for; eagerness ; Abh 766; 945; Vin III 175, 2 (amhākaṃ ca Devadatto ~aṃ ca ruciṃ ca ādāya voharati); D II 312, 26 (anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya ~aṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati); M I 480, 7 (dhamma-nijjhānakkhantiyā sati ~o jāyati chandajāto ussahati); S I 202, 32 (ahu pure dhammapadesu ~o); V 263, 19 (chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhi-padaṃ bhāveti iti me ~o na ca atilīno bhavissati na ca atipaggahīto bhavissati …); 272, 26 (ahosi te pubbe ~o ārāmaṃ gamissāmī ti); A I 229, 7 (tibbo no ~o bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne); II 195, 14 (~o ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca); Ja V 351, 28* (eso cāpi mama ~o ciraṃ passeyya vo ubho); VI 491, 19* (eso ce sivīnaṃ ~o ~aṃ na panudāmase); 517, 9* (na me ~o mati atthi rajjassa-m-anusāsituṃ); Paṭis II 23, 27 (saddhindriyassa bhāvanāya ~o uppajjati); Vibh 208, 27 foll. (yo ~o chandīkatā kattukamyatā kusalo dhammachando ayaṃ vuccati ~o); Cp 3:5:4 (tesaṃ pi ~am ācikkhiṃ); Peṭ 155, 24 (tayo ~ā); Mil 127, 7 (yo tava ~o so hotu); 161, 17 (n’ esā buddhānaṃ adhimutti n’ eso paṇḍitānaṃ ~o); As 132, 38 (kattukamyatālakkhaṇo ~o); — instr. chandena, chandasā, according to one’s will; voluntarily, willingly; according with one’s (own) wishes ; A III 50, 18* (yo ujjubhūtesu dadāti ~asā); Ja II 326, 15* (yaṃ etā upasevanti ~asā vā dhanena vā; 327, 5´ : attano vā ~ena ruciyā pemena); V 452, 28* (tā upenti vividhena ~asā; 454, 24´ : ~asā ti pemena); VI 380, 28* (yā naṃ poseti ~asā piyena); Ap 425, 6 (bhojanaṃ mātuyā mama ~ena nibbattati yadicchakaṃ); Pj II 153, 18 (nāhaṃ arahāmi taṃ attano ~ena kassaci dātun ti); — chandaso, adv. , voluntarily, willingly ; Sp 1302, 33 (yā pana bhikkhunī ~aso methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya; Kkh 2 278, 22 foll. : ~aso ti methunarāgapaṭisaṃyuttena ~ena c’ eva ruciyā ca, ~e pana asati balakkārena padhaṃsitāya anāpatti) ≠ Vin-vn 1965; — ( iii ) consent; esp. consent to an official act of the saṅgha, given by proxy by an absent bhikkhu; Vin I 121, 28 foll. (anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā ~aṃ dātuṃ); 357, 23 (sabbeh’ eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ gilānehi ca agilānehi ca na kehici ~o dātabbo); IV 151, 22 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karontā ekassa ~aṃ adaṃsu); 231, 25 (anaññāya gaṇassa ~aṃ); Ja III 422, 15 (tassa ~aṃ agahetvā samajātikakulā kumārikaṃ ānesi); Sp 1395, 23 (chandārahānaṃ ~aṃ āharitvā); Ps III 16, 22 (sabbesaṃ ~o laddhuṃ vaṭṭati); Vin-vn 2643; — ° âgati , f. , a wrong course of behaviour because of partiality or desire ; Vin III 238, 24 (yo na ~iṃ gaccheyya na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya …); V 167, 34 (kathaṃ ~iṃ gacchati, idh’ ekacco ayaṃ me upajjhāyo vā ācariyo vā … sambhatto vā ñātisālohito vā ti tassānukampāya tassānurakkhāya adhammaṃ dhammo ti dīpeti …); D III 133, 21 (abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu ~iṃ gantuṃ); Vibh 376, 1 ; Sp 581, 27 (yatra satthā pi sāvakesu ~iṃ gacchati); — ° âgamana , n. , a wrong course of behaviour because of partiality ; Ja II 172, 20* (~aṃ na ppasaṃsanti paṇḍitā); Sp 7, 6 ; — ° ânunīta , mfn. , led by desire; led by one’s own will or wishes ; S IV 71, 8* ; Sn 781 (~o ruciyā niviṭṭho; Nidd I 64, 30 : ~o ti sakāya diṭṭhiyā sakāya khantiyā sakāya ruciyā sakāya laddhiyā yāyati niyyati …); — ° âraha , mfn. , entitled to give consent by proxy ; Vin I 318, 17 (~ānaṃ chando āhaṭo hoti); V 221, 32 (avasesā pakatattā ~ā); — °- gāmi(n) , mfn. [chanda + gāmi(n) 1 ], influenced by partiality ; Vin III 183, 34 (te saṅghena pabbājaniya-kamma-katā na sammāvattanti … bhikkhū na khamāpenti akkosanti paribhāsanti °-gāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpenti; Sp 625, 26 foll. : ete ~ino ca … bhayagāmino cā ti evaṃ °-gāmitāya pi … bhayagāmitāya pi pāpenti, yojentī ti attho); 184, 18 (~ino ca bhikkhū dosagāmino bhikkhū …); IV 237, 34 (~iniyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …); — °- gū , mfn. [chanda + gu 1 ], influenced by partiality or one’s desires ; Sn 913 (na ~ū; Nidd I 331, 18 : na chandāgatiṃ gacchati na dosāgatiṃ gacchati … na vaggehi dhammehi yāyati …saṃhariyatī ti na ~ū); — °- tā , f. , will, intention; wanting ; Bv 2:58 (manussattaṃ liṅgasampatti hetu satthāradassanaṃ pabbajjā guṇasampatti adhikāro ca ~ā) = Ps IV 122, 15* = Pj II 48, 16* (49, 19 : ~ā ti kattukamyatā); — °(ā)- nidāna , mfn. , having its origin in appetite ; Sn 865 (~āni piyāni loke, chandā- f. , or mc ?; Pj II 551, 30 : ~ānī ti kāmacchandādi-chandanidānāni); — °- rāga , m. , appetite and desire; desire that is appetite ; D II 58, 34 ; M III 114, 24 (pañcasu kāmaguṇesu ~o); Sn 364 (ādānesu vineyya ~aṃ); Peṭ 161, 17 (kāmacchando ~o pemaṃ nikantī ti vevacanaṃ); — ~âvakaḍḍhana, n. , the removing of appetite and desire ; Spk II 110, 9 ; — nicchandarāga, mfn. , without appetite and desire ; Ja IV 286, 9 ; Ps V 77, 10 (khīṇāsavena katakammaṃ pana nicchandarāgattā kusalaṃ vā akusalaṃ vā na hoti); Spk II 103, 2 ; Mp IV 173, 9 (thero attano sarīre nicchandarāgataṃ kathesi); — sacchandarāga, mfn. , with appetite and desire ; Mp II 148, 23 ; — °- vāsinī , ( m ) f ( n ). [chanda + vāsi(n) 2 ], a wife obtained with her free will ; Vin III 139, 24 (dasa bhariyāyo dhanakkītā ~ī bhogavāsinī …; 140, 1 : ~ī nāma piyo piyaṃ vāseti; Sp 555, 18 : chandena attano ruciyā vasatī ti ~ī … sā na attano chandamatten’ eva bhariyā hoti purisena pana sampaṭicchitattā) ≠ Ps I 199, 19 = Vv-a 73, 2 ; — see also sacchanda ( sv sa 5 ).
